meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会改用 OpenCode 作为后端来运行智能体，支持通过 OpenRouter、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek 等模型。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 中设置 `AGENT_PROVIDER=opencode` 或为群组/会话指定 `agent_provider` 为 `opencode` 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 DeepSeek 模型运行一个智能体任务。
把当前群组的智能体提供商切换到 OpenCode。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses OpenCode as the backend to run agents, supporting models via OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you set `AGENT_PROVIDER=opencode` in NanoClaw or specify `agent_provider` as `opencode` for a group/session.

say_en.text: Run an agent task using the DeepSeek model.
say_en.note: Claude will use OpenCode to invoke the DeepSeek model.

say_en.text: Switch the current group's agent provider to OpenCode.
say_en.note: Claude will update the group config so future sessions use OpenCode.
